section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the increasing trend of cosmetic procedures in developed countries and factors contributing to this rise. It reviews existing literature on correlates of interest in cosmetic surgery, highlighting gender differences and various psychological and social factors. The section then introduces 'the present study', which aims to investigate the association between the 'Consider' subscale of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) and body appreciation, media influence, respondent weight status, and age, predicting specific relationships between these variables.
